1: # Tasks: Add Socratic Investigation Flow & Data Source Expansion
2: 
3: ## Phase 1: Knesset Agent (Priority: High)
4: 
5: ### 1.0 Knesset API Client & Tools
6: - [ ] 1.1 Research and document Knesset Open Data API endpoints (OData + Open Knesset REST)
7: - [ ] 1.2 Create `src/lib/api/knesset/` API client with typed responses
8: - [ ] 1.3 Create `src/lib/tools/knesset/` directory with tool definitions:
9:   - [ ] 1.3.1 `search-legislation.ts` — Search bills by keyword, status, proposer
10:   - [ ] 1.3.2 `get-bill-details.ts` — Get bill details with status history
11:   - [ ] 1.3.3 `search-votes.ts` — Search plenary votes by topic, date
12:   - [ ] 1.3.4 `get-vote-details.ts` — Vote breakdown by party (for/against/abstain)
13:   - [ ] 1.3.5 `search-committee-protocols.ts` — Committee meeting protocols
14:   - [ ] 1.3.6 `get-member-details.ts` — MK details, roles, party
15:   - [ ] 1.3.7 `search-parliamentary-questions.ts` — שאילתות by topic, MK, ministry
16:   - [ ] 1.3.8 `generate-source-url.ts` — Knesset source URL builder

25: - [ ] 2.4 Add knessetAgent to routing agent's `agents: {}` delegation
26: - [ ] 2.5 Update routing agent prompt to know when to delegate to Knesset agent

28: - [ ] 2.7 Verify build + lint + vibecheck pass

30: ## Phase 2: Budget Agent (Priority: High)
31: 
32: ### 3.0 Budget Key API Client & Tools
33: - [ ] 3.1 Research and document Budget Key API endpoints (https://next.obudget.org/api/)
34: - [ ] 3.2 Create `src/lib/api/budget/` API client with typed responses
35: - [ ] 3.3 Create `src/lib/tools/budget/` directory with tool definitions:
36:   - [ ] 3.3.1 `search-budget-items.ts` — Search by keyword, ministry, year
37:   - [ ] 3.3.2 `get-budget-details.ts` — Budget item details (approved vs. actual)
38:   - [ ] 3.3.3 `get-budget-history.ts` — Multi-year budget trend
39:   - [ ] 3.3.4 `search-support-requests.ts` — Government support/transfers
40:   - [ ] 3.3.5 `search-procurement.ts` — Government contracts
41:   - [ ] 3.3.6 `generate-source-url.ts` — Budget Key source URL builder

43: - [ ] 3.5 Add Hebrew tool translations to `src/constants/tool-translations.tsx`

45: 
46: ### 4.0 Budget Sub-Agent
47: - [ ] 4.1 Create `src/agents/network/budget/` directory
48: - [ ] 4.2 Create Budget agent definition with Hebrew system prompt
49: - [ ] 4.3 Register budgetAgent in Mastra instance
50: - [ ] 4.4 Add budgetAgent to routing agent's `agents: {}` delegation
51: - [ ] 4.5 Update routing agent prompt for budget delegation
52: - [ ] 4.6 Add agent display config to `src/constants/agents-display.ts`
53: - [ ] 4.7 Verify build + lint + vibecheck pass
54: 
55: ## Phase 3: Claim Investigation Flow (Priority: Medium)
56: 
57: ### 5.0 Investigation Mode — Agent Side
58: - [ ] 5.1 Update routing agent system prompt with claim-detection heuristics
59: - [ ] 5.2 Create `suggestInvestigationLenses` client tool definition
60: - [ ] 5.3 Define lens types and Hebrew translations for common lens categories:
61:   - תקציבית (budgetary), סטטיסטית (statistical), חקיקתית (legislative), דמוגרפית (demographic)
62: - [ ] 5.4 Update routing agent to orchestrate multi-step investigation:
63:   - Claim parsing → lens suggestion → delegated data retrieval → analysis presentation → conclusion options
64: - [ ] 5.5 Add investigation-related prompts to `src/constants/prompts.ts`
65: - [ ] 5.6 Verify build + lint + vibecheck pass
66: 
67: ### 6.0 Investigation Mode — UI Side
68: - [ ] 6.1 Create `LensSelectionCard` component for displaying lens options
69: - [ ] 6.2 Create `InvestigationProgress` component (step indicator)
70: - [ ] 6.3 Update `MessageItem` to render `suggestInvestigationLenses` tool results
71: - [ ] 6.4 Add investigation-related prompt cards to `EmptyConversation.tsx`
72:   - e.g., "בדוק טענה פוליטית", "חקור הצהרה של פוליטיקאי"
73: - [ ] 6.5 Verify build + lint + vibecheck pass
74: 
75: ## Phase 4: Shareable Output (Priority: Low)
76: 
77: ### 7.0 Shareable Investigation Cards
78: - [ ] 7.1 Create `generateShareableCard` client tool definition
79: - [ ] 7.2 Create `/api/og/investigation` route for server-side card rendering (Satori)
80: - [ ] 7.3 Design Hebrew RTL card template (1200x630, social-optimized)
81: - [ ] 7.4 Create `ShareableCardPreview` component in chat UI
82: - [ ] 7.5 Add download-as-PNG and copy-link actions
83: - [ ] 7.6 Verify build + lint + vibecheck pass
84: 
85: ## Validation & Integration
86: 
87: ### 8.0 End-to-End Testing
88: - [ ] 8.1 Test Knesset agent with real queries (legislation search, vote lookup)
89: - [ ] 8.2 Test Budget agent with real queries (ministry budget, procurement)
90: - [ ] 8.3 Test full investigation flow: claim → lenses → data → conclusion → card
91: - [ ] 8.4 Test cross-agent delegation (investigation using data from 3+ agents)
92: - [ ] 8.5 Verify source URLs are correct and clickable for all new agents
93: - [ ] 8.6 Final build + lint + vibecheck pass
94: 
95: ## Notes
96: 
97: - **Parallelizable**: Phase 1 (Knesset) and Phase 2 (Budget) are independent and can be built in parallel
98: - **Dependencies**: Phase 3 depends on at least one of Phase 1/2 being complete (needs >2 agents for meaningful investigation). Phase 4 depends on Phase 3.
99: - **API Research**: Tasks 1.1 and 3.1 should be done first to validate API availability before committing to tool designs

1: # tool-translation-cleanup
2: 
3: ## MODIFIED Requirements
4: 
5: ### Requirement: Simplified ToolTranslation Interface
6: The `ToolTranslation` interface SHALL contain only `name` (Hebrew display name) and `icon` (LucideIcon component). The `formatInput` and `formatOutput` functions SHALL be removed as they are unused by the rendering pipeline.
7: 
8: #### Scenario: Translation with name and icon only
9: - **GIVEN** a data source defines a tool translation
10: - **WHEN** the translation is registered in the registry
11: - **THEN** it SHALL only require `name` and `icon` fields
12: - **AND** SHALL NOT require `formatInput` or `formatOutput`
13: 
14: #### Scenario: getToolInfo returns name and icon
15: - **GIVEN** a tool name is looked up via `getToolInfo()`
16: - **WHEN** a translation exists for that tool
17: - **THEN** it SHALL return the `name` and `icon` from the translation
18: - **AND** fall back to the raw tool name and `SearchIcon` if no translation exists
19: 
20: ## REMOVED Requirements
21: 
22: ### Requirement: Remove Dead UI Components
23: The following dead code SHALL be removed:
24: - `MessageToolCalls` component (never rendered)
25: - `ToolCallCard` component (never imported)
26: - `getToolDescription()` function (never imported outside barrel export)
27: - `getToolIO()` function (only used internally by dead `MessageToolCalls`)
28: - `ToolIO` type (only used by dead `getToolIO`)
29: 
30: #### Scenario: Dead code removal does not break existing UI
31: - **GIVEN** the dead components and functions are removed
32: - **WHEN** the application builds and renders
33: - **THEN** all existing chat UI functionality SHALL continue working unchanged
34: - **AND** `getToolInfo()` SHALL remain available (it IS used)
35: 
36: ### Requirement: Remove formatInput/formatOutput from existing translations
37: All existing translation files (`datagov.translations.tsx`, `cbs.translations.tsx`, `client/translations.tsx`) SHALL have their `formatInput` and `formatOutput` functions removed, along with any helper functions used only by those formatters.
38: 
39: #### Scenario: Existing DataGov translations simplified
40: - **GIVEN** `datagov.translations.tsx` contains formatting functions and helpers
41: - **WHEN** the cleanup is applied
42: - **THEN** each tool translation SHALL only contain `name` and `icon`
43: - **AND** helper functions (getString, getNumber, getArray, translateSort, etc.) SHALL be removed if unused
44: 
45: ## ADDED Requirements
46: 
47: ### Requirement: Per-Source Resource Extractors
48: Each `DataSourceDefinition` SHALL declare `resourceExtractors` — a partial record mapping tool names to extractor functions that produce chip labels for `AgentInternalCallsChain`.
49: 
50: #### Scenario: Existing extractToolResource logic migrated
51: - **GIVEN** the generic `extractToolResource()` in `ToolCallParts.tsx` contains field extraction logic
52: - **WHEN** it is refactored to per-source extractors
53: - **THEN** each data source SHALL provide its own extractors for tools that produce resource chips
54: - **AND** the generic function SHALL remain as a fallback for tools without a registered extractor
55: 
56: #### Scenario: MCPClient tool resource extraction
57: - **GIVEN** BudgetKey tools are namespaced as `budgetkey_ToolName`
58: - **WHEN** the budget data source provides `resourceExtractors`
59: - **THEN** it SHALL extract display labels from BudgetKey-specific fields (e.g., `dataset` arg, `q` arg)
